intelligence.essence: The Smart Link is the seat's attestation — a clickable link where Shawn can SEE the intelligence, VERIFY it was in the right spot, and confirm it happened. It is the machine-generated Brain markdown, never hand-written, and it is ACTIVE only when the projection lands under the public BRAIN root. A retrievable intelligence twin must not shrink the law — a distillation that compresses a canonical gate list is not a summary, it is an unauthorized amendment. Capture without a receipt check leaks intelligence into chat history — the Smart-Link SLA audit closes the loop, flagging every shared item that has no capture receipt. A Smart Note is not live when it is written — it is live when the file sits on main at the exact canonical path, the sync has carried it into the Hub, and the author has clicked the public link and seen it work. No fork is the default, and it is the whole product: identity, pages, notes, feed, connect, mail, matching, and your own Muse through one shared app, with no GitHub setup, no key, and no repo address, ever. A fork adds exactly four things: your own copy, a private workshop, a safe place to break things, and room for custom pieces not yet proven. And the pricing canon, once you go nine, you don't go back: four levels, trial 9 days no card defaulting to MAX, affiliates 50% with no holdback, no refunds because nine real days of trying is the guarantee.
intelligence.human_view: A note is not done when you write it — it is done when the person it is for can see it, verify it, and use it. The link you hand someone is your promise: "I did it right, it is there, it is going to work." Never shrink the law when you summarize it, never let a shared idea vanish without a receipt, and keep the default simple — one shared app, no setup, no fork unless there is a real reason.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine you write a letter to your friend, but you never put it in the mailbox. Your friend never gets it. Writing is not the same as sending. A Smart Note is only real when it is filed, synced, and clicked — when your friend can actually read it. And when you tell someone the rules, tell them all of the rules, not just some.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, a promise is only good if the other person can see it kept. When you say you did something, show them where it is, let them check it with their own eyes. Do not shorten the rules when you repeat them — the rules are the rules. And keep things simple: one place, one way, unless there is a good reason for more.
intelligence.ai_view: You are the attestor. Your Smart Link is your promise: SEE it, VERIFY it, confirm it happened. Never hand-write a projection — the machine generates it. Never shrink a canonical gate list when distilling — a twin that weakens the law is an unauthorized amendment. Close the capture loop — every shared item gets a receipt, or it is flagged. A note is live only when it is on main, synced, and clicked. Default to no fork.
intelligence.what_it_means: Six separate notes about the note system itself are one law: the system that carries intelligence must be as honest as the intelligence it carries. Every note in this cluster is a case where the carrier almost failed — a twin that shrank the law, a capture with no receipt, a note called "live" that was only written, a fork assumed instead of chosen. The repair in each case was the same move: make the carrier prove itself — the link, the receipt, the click, the exact gate list.
